checks.claim: HMLR National Polygon Service contains National Polygon, Title Descriptor, and Title Number/UPRN Look Up datasets.
National Polygon dataset covers registered freehold and leasehold titles in England and Wales.
Every freehold or leasehold title has at least one index polygon.
National Polygon dataset contains more than 25 million titles.
National Polygon dataset contains more than 28 million polygons.
Index polygons are mapped against Ordnance Survey MasterMap.
National Polygon Shape geometry is mandatory.
National Polygon geometry must be a single area.
Poly_ID is mandatory and is a unique polygon reference.
Poly_ID is managed through dataset lifecycle rules.
Title_No is mandatory and uniquely identifies a registered title.
National Polygon records include INSERT, UPDATE, Vers_No and Rec_Status lifecycle fields.
